changelog: Settings pages are tabs, and each group of settings a card in one column with labels above the fields.

Carriers are one list instead of a table per country: each with its initials, name, country and link's site, a switch, and an Edit panel for its name and link. A search and Show and Country filters (Suggested by default: what is on plus the store's country and Global) find a carrier among the 1,000-odd; "Add a carrier" holds the full list and your own. The fields saved are the same.
Admin styles use WordPress 7.0's design tokens, so they follow the admin colour scheme.
